verdict.rationale: A tax authority could publish third-party authorization forms, delegate roles, and limits on what a representative may sign, so this axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two probes recording HTTP 403 Akamai denials at the front-door robots.txt and the webapp host. Nothing in it documents authorization forms, roles, or which signatures stay personal, so there is no evidence the capability is published.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
